item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-b03ec60612ef814a","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In 2023, the DRC government filed a complaint with the International Criminal Court seeking investigation and prosecution of persons involved in alleged human-rights and international-humanitarian-law violations committed in eastern DRC during 2022–2023 by the Rwanda–M23 coalition; the complaint also alleged systematic plunder of natural resources.","question_ids":["2B.9","3B.4","3B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The complaint concerned conduct during 2022–2023 and was reported as a 2023 action, although the supplied page was updated in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The filing was made by the DRC government under President Félix Tshisekedi; the article specifically attributed the filing statement to Justice Minister Rose Mutombo.","limitations":["The source reports the government’s allegations and referral, not a final ICC finding or completed remedy.","The source does not establish the president’s personal role in drafting or directing the complaint."]},{"source_id":"SRC-930796f446c0d354a","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"At his January 2024 inauguration following the December 2023 election, Félix Tshisekedi publicly swore to observe and defend the Constitution and laws, respect human rights, promote the common good and peace, and serve the Congolese people loyally.","question_ids":["4B.8","7B.8","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The oath followed the 2023 election but occurred in January 2024, outside the target period; it is relevant as a dated statement about the end of the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were made personally by Félix Tshisekedi in his presidential oath.","limitations":["This is a formal commitment, not evidence of implementation or outcomes during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a3cc893a0c1a2dc4","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The CENCO-ECC election-observation mission reported that voting occurred in military schools and academies; the CENI’s second vice-president rejected the allegation and demanded proof. The mission’s report stated that 204 reviewed reports, or 11.26%, documented polling stations in military academies or schools.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","7B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The dispute concerned the December 20, 2023 elections.","ruler_attribution":"The reported statements were by the CENI and its second vice-president, not directly by Tshisekedi; the CENI operated within the state institutions overseeing the election.","limitations":["The source presents conflicting claims and does not resolve whether voting actually occurred at the cited military locations.","It does not establish a direct presidential order or response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1630347b7cb98edb","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"LAMUKA publicly criticized Tshisekedi’s security strategy in eastern DRC, arguing that he relied on East African Community forces and even engaged South Sudan’s military rather than relying primarily on Congolese forces; it called this a risky, short-term approach and demanded M23 withdrawal from occupied areas.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The criticism and described reliance on EAC forces were reported on January 2, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reported reliance on EAC and South Sudanese forces was attributed to Tshisekedi by LAMUKA spokesperson Prince Epenge; the evaluative characterization was LAMUKA’s.","limitations":["The source is an opposition statement and does not independently verify the scale, terms, or results of Tshisekedi’s regional-force policy.","The article does not report a completed security outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-94b5e31554bcb066","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi appointed Judith Suminwa Tuluka prime minister in April 2024. Before the appointment she had served as planning minister and deputy coordinator of the Presidential Council for Strategic Monitoring, and had prior experience in the budget ministry and as a UNDP peacebuilding and democracy coordinator; she became the DRC’s first woman prime minister.","question_ids":["4B.5","5B.2","6B.4","8B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The appointment occurred in April 2024, outside the target period; the prior roles and appointment are not 2023 evidence.","ruler_attribution":"The appointment was made by Félix Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The event is outside 2023–2023 and therefore has limited period fit.","The source does not show subsequent performance, independence, or implementation results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4f70369262471615","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Constitutional Court validated 26 presidential candidacies for the December 2023 election, rejected challenges to Moïse Katumbi’s and Félix Tshisekedi’s candidacies as unfounded, and reinstated two candidates previously excluded by the CENI.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The court ruling was issued on October 30, 2023, during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The decisions were issued by the Constitutional Court; the source does not attribute them to Tshisekedi personally.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether Tshisekedi influenced the court or election administration.","Validation of candidacies does not by itself establish a genuinely fair or competitive election."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9562ae4d9ace0887","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The CENCO-ECC preliminary election-observation report documented multiple anomalies that it said could compromise the integrity of results in some locations. It urged the CENI, Constitutional Court, and other judicial bodies to consider the findings and called for provisional results based on complete compilations from all local results centers under Electoral Law article 71.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","7B.1"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report concerned the December 20, 2023 elections and was published on December 28, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings and recommendations were made by the independent CENCO-ECC observation mission; the source does not show a direct Tshisekedi response.","limitations":["The report is preliminary and does not by itself prove presidential responsibility for the anomalies.","The source does not state whether the CENI or courts implemented the recommendations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bf2c6c27f5145620","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In March 2023, residents and observers in Goma identified removing the M23 and ADF as major security challenges for the national government and said that hundreds of thousands of displaced people could return only after hostilities ended; residents reported that security had been deteriorating for at least 23 years.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.9","3B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The reported security conditions and public expectations were current in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source concerned Tshisekedi’s national government and the newly appointed defense minister, but the quoted assessments came from residents and observers rather than the president.","limitations":["The source reports perceived insecurity and displacement, not a quantified presidential decision or independently measured change caused by Tshisekedi.","The baseline extends beyond Tshisekedi’s tenure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4270c269830d2081","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The UDPS extraordinary congress designated Félix Tshisekedi as its presidential candidate for the December 2023 election, confirming his previously stated intention to seek a second term; the election calendar set voting for December 23.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.8","8B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The party designation occurred on August 26, 2023, during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The candidacy was formally endorsed by Tshisekedi’s party, while Tshisekedi had publicly expressed his intention to seek reelection.","limitations":["The source does not show whether the candidacy complied with or threatened constitutional term limits.","It provides no evidence about campaign conduct, electoral fairness, or implementation of a policy program."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4e1e0b5bfc86cfba","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"During partial and provisional counting in the December 2023 presidential election, 9,333,562 ballots had been processed and Tshisekedi led with 7,219,816 votes, or 77.35%. Opposition candidates alleged ballot stuffing, fraud, repression of supporters, and questioned the credibility of the tabulation and Constitutional Court.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","7B.1","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures and allegations were reported on December 28, 2023, while counting remained partial and provisional.","ruler_attribution":"The vote lead was attributed to provisional election results; allegations of fraud and repression were made by opposition figures, not established as findings against Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The results were incomplete and provisional.","The source reports allegations and political reactions without independently resolving whether fraud, repression, or manipulation occurred."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7e27c49e0d50ad7f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"During partial and provisional counting in the December 2023 presidential election, 9,333,562 ballots had been processed and Tshisekedi led with 7,219,816 votes, or 77.35%. Opposition candidates alleged ballot stuffing, fraud, repression of supporters, and questioned the credibility of the tabulation and Constitutional Court.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","7B.1","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures and allegations were reported on December 28, 2023, while counting remained partial and provisional.","ruler_attribution":"The vote lead was attributed to provisional election results; allegations of fraud and repression were made by opposition figures, not established as findings against Tshisekedi.","limitations":["This source duplicates the same article and information as SRC-4e1e0b5bfc86cfba.","The results were incomplete and provisional.","The source reports allegations and political reactions without independently resolving whether fraud, repression, or manipulation occurred."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-069ecffc23ee4aa4"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus contains several reports about institutions, opposition statements, or provisional election information rather than direct presidential decisions.","No supplied document provides concrete 2023 evidence for nuclear-risk governance, proliferation controls, AI/biological safeguards, macroeconomic policy, social-service delivery, or personal financial integrity.","The January and April 2024 documents were retained only where they provide dated commitments or appointments connected to the 2023 transition; their period fit is limited."]}
